The amber garden trial reported stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from purely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Invented learning-garden trial records supplied in the public synthetic fixture
- Reports a recall outcome after guided sessions

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not present in the supplied fixture

## Query log
- 2026-10-07: supplied synthetic fixture fixture-001.json (invented-index); no live backend searches run. Hits: 2.

## Screening
- amber (Lumen, 2024): included, evidence
- ivory (Vale, 2024): included, evidence

## Notes
- Claims, sources, and synthesis wording are copied verbatim from the fixture for deterministic integrity evaluation.
The amber garden trial reported 64% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
